entries.title: Hosea 9:1
segments: ¶Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as [other] people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor. {upon: or, in, etc}

words.text: : for thou hast gone a whoring

entries.title: Hosea 9:2
segments: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her. {winepress: or, winefat}

entries.title: Hosea 9:3
segments: They shall not dwell in the LORD'S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean [things] in Assyria.

entries.title: Hosea 9:4
segments: They shall not offer wine [offerings] to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices [shall be] unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.

words.text: [shall be] unto them as the bread

entries.title: Hosea 9:5
segments: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?

entries.title: Hosea 9:6
segments: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant [places] for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns [shall be] in their tabernacles. {destruction: Heb. spoil} {the...: or, their silver shall be desired, the nettle, etc.: Heb. the desire}

words.text: . {destruction: Heb. spoil} {the...: or, their silver shall be desired, the nettle, etc.: Heb. the desire}

entries.title: Hosea 9:7
segments: ¶The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know [it]: the prophet [is] a fool, the spiritual man [is] mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred. {spiritual...: Heb. man of the spirit}

entries.title: Hosea 9:8
segments: The watchman of Ephraim [was] with my God: [but] the prophet [is] a snare of a fowler in all his ways, [and] hatred in the house of his God. {in the: or, against the}

entries.title: Hosea 9:9
segments: They have deeply corrupted [themselves], as in the days of Gibeah: [therefore] he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

entries.title: Hosea 9:10
segments: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: [but] they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto [that] shame; and [their] abominations were according as they loved.

entries.title: Hosea 9:11
segments: ¶[As for] Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

entries.title: Hosea 9:12
segments: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, [that there shall] not [be] a man [left]: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

words.text: them, [that there shall] not [be] a man
also to them when I depart

entries.title: Hosea 9:13
segments: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, [is] planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

entries.title: Hosea 9:14
segments: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts. {miscarrying: Heb. that casteth the fruit}

entries.title: Hosea 9:15
segments: All their wickedness [is] in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes [are] revolters.

entries.title: Hosea 9:16
segments: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay [even] the beloved [fruit] of their womb. {the...: Heb. the desires}

entries.title: Hosea 9:17
segments: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

words.text: unto him: and they shall be wanderers
